title: Missing moeb tool: Bash (cargo_test)
description: Used Bash to run cargo build --release and cargo test in src/moeb/ for build and test verification. No moeb tool exists for executing the project build or test suite, forcing moeb-tool-origin Fail.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a run_tests tool that executes cargo test in a specified directory and returns the result.

title: phase-5a-in-all-skills rubric criterion uses hardcoded phase number instead of heading text
description: The phase-5a-in-all-skills rubric criterion in moeb.mcp-thinking-block-capture checks for the literal string 'Phase 5a' in all three skill files. In spec.skill.md and fix_signal.skill.md the Reasoning Review is Phase 7b, so the Push Thinking Blocks phase is correctly Phase 7a in those files. The criterion should match on heading text ('Push Thinking Blocks') rather than a hardcoded phase number to be robust across skill files with differing phase numbering.
proposed_resolution: When authoring rubric criteria that check for phase insertions across multiple skill files, match on the heading text of the new phase rather than a specific phase number, since phase numbers differ across run.skill.md, spec.skill.md, and fix_signal.skill.md.

title: push_thinking_blocks tool unavailable in MCP session until server restart after first build
description: In the first run after implementing push_thinking_blocks, the tool exists in the new binary but the currently-running MCP server process uses the old binary and does not expose the tool. Phase 5a called push_thinking_blocks and received 'No such tool available', so thinking blocks were not captured and Phase 5b was skipped. The tool will be available in subsequent MCP sessions after the server is restarted with the new binary.
proposed_resolution: This is a bootstrap limitation inherent to adding new MCP tools. No code change is needed. Users should restart the MCP server after deploying a new binary that adds tools.
